chart_review_items.title: Complete axis-domain controls
chart_review_items.current_state: Numeric-scale helper/UI implement linear and symlog; calendar-specific support is separate work.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Users can control view domains without accidentally changing record selection.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit bounds and reset/lock behavior are specified.
A true logarithmic option explicitly handles nonpositive values.
Zoom and filter actions are distinguishable.
Brush pixels invert to raw numeric values correctly under every supported scale.
Saved settings restore domains and selection consistently.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Explain the population that determines a scale
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Full-source facet domains and additional chart traces make some scale choices inspectable.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: No uniform full/working/visible population switch is established. Preserve stable domains under own brushing and disclose exceptions.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Zoom a numerical axis without changing the row subset
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Map viewport/camera behavior is distinct from analytical filters; common 2D brushes select rows.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: No universal 2D axis zoom/reset contract is established. Do not confuse saved axis options or map pan with common chart zoom.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Use linear, categorical, symlog and calendar scales meaningfully
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: The manifest now supports UTC time specifically for Line Chart calendar summaries, alongside linear, band and symlog.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: True log remains explicitly unsupported. Raw numeric days are not dates; calendar support must not be generalized to all date-like axes.

current_assessment.statement: numericScale.ts chooses symlog or linear. ECDF uses scaleLog through its own logX option. AxisSettings contains min and max but broad renderer support is not established. Existing brushes use numerical inversion. Calendar and map-specific controls do not establish a common 2D domain contract.
current_assessment.evidence_scope: Source inspection only; no fresh application browser proof.
